findings.title: Annotation/dimension folders: VV 44/45 vs TV 43/44
findings.detail: Both apps have the same 8 annotation and 15 dimension file names; only the folder numbers differ (VV n+1 = TV n). The realign plan section 4.1 fixed this map for the whole re-alignment, and every import in both apps already uses it. Renumbering would touch every importer (FloorPlan/Elevation mode controllers, MarkupMount, MarkupBridge, Toolbar) for no functional gain.
findings.recommendation: Keep VV 44__System__PlanAnnotations and 45__System__PlanDimensions. Record the mapping in the ledger, and translate folder numbers when porting hunks.
findings.evidence: TV/TrueVision__PLAN__ValeVisionRealign__DrawingSystems__.md:304-321 (folder map 'Fixed for the whole of this work')

findings.title: No VV folder for TV 49__System__ElevationDepthFog; the n+1 shift cannot extend past 47
findings.detail: TV adds 47 DrawingPlanes, 48 CrossSectionViews and 49 ElevationDepthFog. VV has 47 NorthDirection and 50 ProjectedLinework, so only 48 and 49 are free and the n+1 shift would collide at 50. The 50/51 precedent (same number in both apps) avoids that. Na__Test__ElevationDepthFog__ reads 02__Src__AppModules/49__System__ElevationDepthFog by path.
findings.recommendation: Create VV 02__Src__AppModules/49__System__ElevationDepthFog with TV's file names and namespaces unchanged. Apply the same 'same number above 47' rule to 47 and 48 in their slices.
findings.evidence: VV 02__Src__AppModules listing (40-47, 50, 51; 48 and 49 free); TV listing (47, 48, 49); realign plan :320 (50/51 shared numbers)

findings.title: VV 29__System__FogPlaneSystem is a 3D-view fog, not a drawing fog; no overlap with the depth fog
findings.detail: Two face-picked world planes, a fall-off, a camera forcefield, Alt+Shift+F, and a top-level FogPlane__Config saved through R2SaveProjectJson. It is a composer ShaderPass that replaced VV's old orbit-anchored radial fog (TV still has the radial one). ComposerPreset turns it off for every drawing and back on afterwards. Namespaces (Na__FogPlane vs Na__ElevFog), storage and data are all different. Its file names lack the trailing __ (legacy).
findings.recommendation: Keep it as a VV-only 3D feature. Do not reuse it for drawings - it cannot fade the fat linework or the projected vectors. Port TV's 49 depth fog beside it.
findings.evidence: VV 42/Na__DrawView__ComposerPreset__.js:290,301,341 (fog plane off in drawings); VV 29/Na__FogPlaneSystem__FogShaderEffect.js header ('Replaces the old orbit-anchored radial fog')

findings.title: File names and namespaces identical across 43/44/49/50; only identity text differs
findings.detail: Na__PlanAnnotations__*, Na__PlanDimensions__*, Na__ProjectedLinework__* and Na__ElevationDepthFog__* file names, and the namespaces Na__PlanAnno, Na__PlanDim, Na__Pl* and Na__ElevFog*, match exactly. The only differences are the console prefix ([TrueVision3D] vs [ValeVision3D]), header title lines, and identity strings such as TrueVision__ vs ValeVision__ category and owner keys.
findings.recommendation: No renames. Keep VV's identity seams (console prefix, header titles, ValeVision__ category and owner keys) when porting.
findings.evidence: Normalised diffs (app names and folder numbers normalised) show no symbol-name differences in any shared file

findings.title: Snapshot history file name differs: VV Na__AppUtils__SnapshotHistory__.js vs TV Na__AppUtils__SnapshotHistory.js
findings.detail: In each app, the History modules of both annotations and dimensions import the shared factory under that app's own file name, so these four files never copy verbatim. The file belongs to the 03__AppUtils slice. The ledger records it as a 'file name suffix' divergence.
findings.recommendation: Align in the 03 slice. Prefer TV renaming to the house __ suffix and updating its two History imports; VV then needs no change.
findings.evidence: Normalised diffs of both History modules (import path only); VV ledger :986 'File name suffix'

findings.title: Plan annotation Toolbar 1.1.0: Colour Palette attach (TV v2.126.0)
findings.detail: TV's Toolbar imports Na__ColourPalette__Attach from ../54__Feature__ColourPalette/Na__ColourPalette__.js and calls it once on the dimension colour <input type=color>. VV's Toolbar is 1.0.0 and VV has no 54 folder. TV's Na__Test__ColourPalette__ fails by name on any colour input built without Attach.
findings.recommendation: After the ColourPalette port, add the import and the one call to VV's Toolbar. Keep VV's GetTextSetup import from 45/...ConfigState__.js, and log it as Toolbar 1.1.0 (TV numbering).
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +6/-3; TV Toolbar header 21-Sep-2026 1.1.0; TV devlog v2.126.0 :3982 ('Na__PlanAnnotations__Toolbar__ 1.1.0 attaches the dimension colour')

findings.title: Seven of eight annotation files are code-identical
findings.detail: Data, Editor, History, Hotkeys, Overlay, Styles and AppConfig show no normalised code difference beyond two items: the SnapshotHistory file name and the AppConfig description wording ('project.json' vs 'TrueVision__ProjectData__.json'). The rows drift_all marks 'header-only' differ only in PORT NOTE and devlog text.
findings.recommendation: No code action. Refresh the PORT NOTEs (Toolbar source version) in the ledger and header work package.
findings.evidence: Normalised diff counts: Data/Editor/Hotkeys/Overlay/Styles 0/0; History 2/2 (import name); AppConfig 1/1 (description)

findings.title: Plan dimensions: VV's split (ConfigState, EditorPreview) is the target - do NOT copy TV's Data or Editor
findings.detail: Behaviour is identical in both apps. VV moved the config layer to ConfigState and the preview to EditorPreview (VV Data 662 lines, Editor 843), and nine VV consumers import from ConfigState. TV still holds both regions inline (Data 989, Editor 908, both over its 900-line budget). Copying TV's Data or Editor over VV's would create a second config state and break those nine import sites.
findings.recommendation: Leave VV's 15 files as they are, and mark them keep_vv_divergence in the ledger until TV is rewired (S02b-F09). Exclude Na__PlanDimensions__Data__.js and __Editor__.js from any 'copy the TV file' pass.
findings.evidence: Normalised diff Data +315/-10, Editor +88/-21 (config and preview regions only); VV 45 headers 'Dimension config getters imported from Na__PlanDimensions__ConfigState__.js'

findings.title: TV copied VV's dimension split but never wired it: duplicate config, orphan modules
findings.detail: TV's ConfigState__ and EditorPreview__ arrived on 10-Sep 'verbatim', but no TV consumer uses them. TV's mode controllers load Data's own config. TV's MarkupBridge (:259) is ConfigState's only real importer, so it reads ConfigState's never-loaded fallbacks. Today only FontFamily differs from the JSON, but any later JSON edit will not reach the Layout Editor's plan-dimension markup in TV.
findings.recommendation: TV-side, on Adam's approval: point all nine consumers and both mode controllers at ConfigState, have Editor use EditorPreview, and delete the duplicated regions. Both folders then become code-identical.
findings.evidence: TV 44/Na__PlanDimensions__Data__.js:259,949 (Load); TV 42 FloorPlan ModeController :160-163; TV MarkupBridge :259; nothing in TV imports EditorPreview__

findings.title: Ledger: dimension split recorded as closed; phase 2/4 rows do not track TV-to-VV deltas
findings.detail: Ledger :34-37 lists 'dimension config and preview splits' as closed, while :1220 still lists it as pending and TV is not wired. The phase 4 rows (:1011-1039, checked 09-Sep) compare VV with the Lantern Designer only. None of TV's v2.32.0, v2.37.0, v2.42.0, v2.48.1, v2.105.0, v2.140.0 or v2.159.0 linework changes has a row; only the 13-Sep and 18-Sep return trips cover part of folder 50.
findings.recommendation: Correct the split row to 'VV split; TV copied, not wired'. Add a return-trip section for each landed work package, with module versions and seams. Note Toolbar 1.1.0 (colour palette) under phase 2.
findings.evidence: ValeVision__PARITY__TrueVisionLedger__.md:34-37, :982-985, :1011-1039, :1220

findings.title: Projected linework AppConfig: rule switches, Storeys block, LineworkModifiers block, BuildToken
findings.detail: TV's JSON adds Projection__HideFlushJoins (true), SeamsOcclude (true) and LineworkFirst (false) (v2.37.0); ProjectedLinework__Storeys__Config (prefix Storey__, FloorToleranceMm 500, AnnotationTokens Linetype__DoorSwings/ClearanceLines; v2.105.0); ProjectedLinework__LineworkModifiers__Config (tags 76-79 mapped to TrueVision__LineworkModifier__FineDetail/VeryFineDetail); BuildToken 2026-09-23-flush-tolerance (VV has 2026-09-18-linetype-annotation); and the DiffLabel 'Run Diff'.
findings.recommendation: Merge TV's JSON. Rewrite the OwnerKeys with the ValeVision__ prefix, and set a new VV BuildToken that equals the ConfigAccess fallback. Keep VV's Appearance block and VV's Main config ProjectedLinework__Config exclusion override.
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +25/-5; TV AppConfig :108-114 (modifier rows), :120 (token); VV AppConfig :98 (token)

findings.title: Na__ProjectedLinework__FlushJoins__.js (TV-only, 1.1.0): flush joins cut before the clip
findings.detail: Removes from the model's own edges every stretch where faces of one plane lie on both sides of the edge (wall bands, piers, a new wall carrying straight on from an old one). Authored linework never passes through it. In 1.1.0 (v2.159.0) both tolerances rose to 1e-4 m after RB05's 13-micron storey seam drew a line across every elevation. It imports nothing, so it is worker-safe. VV has no such file and no HideFlushJoins code, so VV elevations draw these lines today.
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim (header and console prefix only) together with CpuBackend 1.3.0+ and ConfigAccess 1.1.0+. Port Na__Test__FlushJoins__.test.mjs alongside it.
findings.evidence: TV 50/...FlushJoins__.js:99-100 (1e-4); TV devlog v2.37.0 :12893, v2.159.0 :1017; search of VVM for FlushJoin/SeamsOcclude/LineworkFirst returns nothing

findings.title: ClipKernel 1.2.0: SeamsOcclude
findings.detail: With settings.SeamsOcclude on, a triangle side lying exactly along the edge counts as the crossing. An edge behind the seam between two occluders is then hidden, as the depth buffer hides it in 3D. With it off, the output is byte-identical to before (Run Diff runs it off). VV is at 1.1.0 (owner tags, which TV also has).
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole and re-apply only the header and console prefix. After the port, Run Diff (cpu vs legacy) must still agree.
findings.evidence: TV 50/...ClipKernel__.js:308 and the on1&&on2 branch; normalised diff +8/-1

findings.title: EdgeExtractor 1.3.0: linework-first category set
findings.detail: ExtractStageEdges and ExtractIntersectionEdges take an optional set of the categories that ship SketchUp linework. Those categories keep only their silhouettes and are never intersection-tested against each other, and bounds trees are built only when a test needs them. With no set, the output is byte-identical to 1.2.0. The D40 rotation path and owner tags are already identical in both apps.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole and re-apply the header and console prefix only.
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +41/-10; TV header 14-Sep-2026 1.3.0; TV devlog v2.37.0

findings.title: AuthoredEdges 1.2.0: Categories set and per-node LineworkModifier owners (unlogged)
findings.detail: 1.2.0 (v2.37.0): Collect returns Categories, the categories whose linework root holds at least one segment, recorded before the visibility test. A later change on 20-Sep tags each nested LineworkModifier node with its own owner via Na__PlSampler__ModifierOwnerFor and Na__PlCfg__GetLineworkModifiers. That change is not logged in the file header.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole and re-apply the header and console prefix. Log both changes in VV's header (1.2.0 plus a modifier note).
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +54/-17; TV imports GetLineworkModifiers and ModifierOwnerFor; TV header logs only 1.2.0

findings.title: ConfigAccess 1.2.0: rule switches, GetStoreySetup, GetLineworkModifiers
findings.detail: Adds lineworkFirst, seamsOcclude and hideFlushJoins to GetProjectionSetup (1.1.0), GetStoreySetup (1.2.0) and GetLineworkModifiers (unlogged), all with fallbacks. Two TV defects: the fallback buildToken '2026-09-21-storey-swings' is not the JSON's '2026-09-23-flush-tolerance', and the comment above GetAnnotationSetup reads 'Get the Model Sampling Setup'.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole. Re-apply the ValeVision__ OwnerKey prefix in the fallbacks and set the fallback buildToken to VV's new JSON token (the StoreyBand test checks fallbacks against the JSON). Fix the comment.
findings.evidence: TV 50/...ConfigAccess__.js:129 (fallback token) vs AppConfig__.json:120; :389 (comment); normalised diff +57/-2

findings.title: CpuBackend 1.4.0: rules into the kernel, flush joins, storey band for annotation
findings.detail: 1.3.0 (v2.37.0): SeamsOcclude is posted to the workers, the linework-first set goes into both extractions, and Na__PlFlush__CutFlushJoins runs on the view-space model edges before the clip. 1.4.0 (v2.105.0): on a plan, annotation whose owner matches Storeys.AnnotationTokens is kept to the band of the storey the cut passes through, and the storey is reported. VV 1.2.1 already has SplitAnnotation (TV 1.3.1).
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole once FlushJoins and Storeys exist, and re-apply the header and console prefix.
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +34/-8; TV header 1.3.0 (14-Sep), 1.4.0 (21-Sep)

findings.title: ModelStage: edge rules in the fingerprint (TV 1.1.0)
findings.detail: Describe adds the edges, seams and joins rule names to the fingerprint, so linework baked under one setting is never restored under another. VV's ModelStage 1.1.0 is TV's 1.2.0 (content stamp) without this change - the version numbers collide.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole (1.2.0) and re-apply the header and the 42__System__DrawingViewCore import path. Adopt TV's version number (D-S02b-10).
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +4/-0; TV PORT NOTE ':51 1.1.0 PENDING ... 1.2.0 ported 18-Sep as ValeVision3D v2.57.0 (its 1.1.0)'

findings.title: DevMenu Controls 1.1.0: rule readouts and Diff note
findings.detail: The timings table gains 'Linework first', 'Seams occlude' and 'Flush joins' rows, and the Diff note says both sides ran without the 3D-matching rules. VV's own 1.1.0 is different content: the edge-style backend wording, which TV also has.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole and re-apply the header and the 42 import path. This is localhost-only UI.
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +16/-4; TV header 14-Sep-2026 1.1.0; VV header 13-Sep-2026 1.1.0 (edge styles)

findings.title: Projector 1.5.0: rules in BuildOptions, door pose around Collect, storeys measured per collection
findings.detail: 1.2.0 (v2.37.0): the three rules, forced off for a named backend. 1.3.0 (v2.42.0): door pose Apply and SwingEdges around Collect. 1.4.0 (v2.48.1): PutBack and the shut pose. 1.5.0 (v2.105.0): the storey rule, with Na__PlDoors__Storeys run on EVERY collection (:359), so this file needs DoorPose and the door module even when no drawing has a pose. VV 1.1.1 already has TV 1.4.1 (annotation tokens).
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole after the door module work package, and re-apply the header and console prefix.
findings.evidence: TV 50/...Projector__.js:138 (DoorPose import), :359 (storeys every collection), :370 (pose); normalised diff +66/-6

findings.title: Pipeline 1.5.0: optional model root, linework-first/door-pose/storey keys, swings
findings.detail: 1.2.0 (v2.32.0): optional modelRoot in RenderDefinition and fingerprint in GetCached (TV design phases; harmless with no caller). 1.3.0: linework-first (lf0/lf1) in the collection key, plus report fields. 1.4.0: door pose hash in the key, and AppendSwings. 1.5.0: storey band in the key, a tally of off-storey swings, and the storey in the report. VV 1.1.0 already has ForgetCollections (v2.64.1), which neither app logs.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole, keeping the model-root seam (D-S02b-08). Re-apply folder paths 42->43 (FloorPlan), 45->46 (Elevation) and 40->42 (DrawingViewCore) and the header, and log ForgetCollections.
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +60/-19; TV PORT NOTE :50-56; VV Pipeline :585 ForgetCollections

findings.title: StageSampler 1.2.0: posed door panels, LineworkModifier owners
findings.detail: 1.1.0 (v2.42.0): with rules.posedMods, meshes under a posed panel keep a COPY of their matrix, and the result names PosedModsDrawn. 1.2.0 (20-Sep, no TV devlog entry): Na__PlSampler__ModifierOwnerFor styles a mesh whose node name begins with a 76-79 tag under that tag's owner key. It is a prefix match because three.js strips '::' from node names. Without posedMods or modifiers, nothing changes.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole and re-apply the header and the comment examples (ValeVision__ keys).
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +62/-14; TV header 20-Sep 1.2.0 and 14-Sep 1.1.0

findings.title: ViewDefinition 1.2.0: door pose in the definition and record hash
findings.detail: FromPlan and FromElevation take a fourth argument, doorPose, which Na__PlView__DoorPose normalises and adds to the hash only when it is set, so every existing hash is unchanged. TV's Flags function reads both the Styles__X and x spellings; VV's reads one. Both return the same value, because GetStyles returns flag names in both apps.
findings.recommendation: Take TV's file whole and re-apply folder paths 42->43 and 45->46 and the header. Accept TV's Flags.
findings.evidence: Normalised diff +50/-21; TV FpData STYLE_KEYS :157-163 = VV :129-135

findings.title: Na__ProjectedLinework__DoorPose__.js (TV-only, 1.3.0)
findings.detail: Plans draw doors open with swing arcs (v2.42.0). Elevations and sections draw them shut, with PutBack (v2.48.1). One storey per plan (v2.105.0: StoreySamples, Storeys, StoreyBand). The hit test ignores swing ground when swings are hidden (v2.140.0). It has 13 exports, used by Projector, Pipeline, LE PlanDoors and SnapshotRenderer, and it imports TV door module 1.9.0 exports and FindDoorGroups, which VV lacks.
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim (header and console prefix) in the folder 50 work package, after the door module work package. With no Layout Editor caller, definitions carry DoorPose null and only the storey measurement runs.

findings.title: Na__ProjectedLinework__Storeys__.js (TV-only, 1.0.0)
findings.detail: A pure module (imports nothing). A plan belongs to the storey with the highest floor at or below its cut. Each floor is the median of the door bottoms in its Storey__<Key>__ group, and the band keeps storey-bound annotation. It matches 'Storey__' anywhere in a name, so VV's MultiModel Storey__${name}__${element} categories qualify. With fewer than two storeys it returns null and every drawing is unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Port verbatim together with Na__Test__StoreyBand__.test.mjs (53 checks). Keep the ConfigAccess storey fallbacks equal to the JSON.
findings.evidence: TV 50/...Storeys__.js:71, :86-98 (unanchored key); VV 15/Na__ModelLoader__MultiModel.js:146,194 (Storey__ categories)

findings.title: Door module (25) must reach the TV 1.9.0 exports, plus FindDoorGroups, before any folder 50 port
findings.detail: DoorPose imports Na__DoorAnimation__FindDoorGroups (a TV-only file) and MOD_TYPE_ROT_ONLY, MOD_TYPE_FIXED, DescribeDoors, ComputePanelLocalPose, ApplyPanelTransform and GetLiveProgress (TV 1.9.0). VV 1.7.1 exports none of them. ES modules link all-or-nothing, so taking TV's Projector, Pipeline or CpuBackend before this breaks Na__PlPipe__Initialize, the Dev section and every Layout Editor 2D viewport.
findings.recommendation: Merge TV 1.8.0 and 1.9.0 onto VV 1.7.1, keeping VV's own SnapAllClosed, Get/SetSpeedScale and GetBaseDurationMs (used by Video Studio). Port FindDoorGroups verbatim, and gate the change with Na__Verify__Exports__ and ModuleGraph.
findings.evidence: TV 25/...ClickToOpenDoors__.js:47-60 (1.9.0); VV same file :43-56 (1.7.1); export diff: 11 TV-only, 4 VV-only; FindDoorGroups absent from VVM/25

findings.title: Persistence 1.2.1 FolderId is TV-only (DIV-4): keep VV's folder resolution
findings.detail: TV 1.2.1 reads assets from the URL's year and project folder because that is where TV's bake uploads. VV uploads (R2AssetUpload:199) and fetches (Persistence:447) through Na__AppUtils__NormalizeProjectFolderId(projectCode), so the two already agree, under VaApps/Projects/{folderId}/. Copying TV's line would send VV's fetches to the wrong folder.
findings.recommendation: When taking any TV Persistence hunk, keep VV's NormalizeProjectFolderId import and FetchAsset line. Record it in the PORT NOTE as a permanent DIV-4 seam.
findings.evidence: TV Persistence :457-467 (FolderId); VV Persistence :78,447; VV R2AssetUpload :199

findings.title: Persistence bake gate: use Na__DevGate__IsAuthoringEnabled (TD01), like the rest of VV
findings.detail: TV's BakeBeforeSave returns early unless DevGate says authoring is enabled. VV's still checks Na__AppUtils__IsRunningOnLocalhost (:597), although VV has DevGate 1.1.0 and its Layout Editor loader, mode controller and dev tools already use it. Behaviour change: an explicit lock now stops baking on localhost, and ?authoring=on lets an installed app bake.
findings.recommendation: Replace the localhost check with Na__DevGate__IsAuthoringEnabled(), imported from 03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__DevGate__.js.
findings.evidence: TV Persistence :110,:617; VV Persistence :597; VV ledger :1187 (DevGate 1.1.0 verbatim)

findings.title: Eleven linework files are code-identical; WebGpuBackend differs only in comments
findings.detail: ClipWorker, WorkerPool, DiffHarness, Owners, ExportCompositor, FlatBvh, RasterPreview, Scheduler, SoupBuilder, SvgOverlay and Styles__Main show no normalised code difference. drift_all marks some as 'drifted' only because of console prefixes and comments. WebGpuBackend differs in comment wording only.
findings.recommendation: No code work. Optionally sync the WebGpuBackend comments verbatim, and refresh the PORT NOTEs to 'verbatim with TV x.y.z'.
findings.evidence: Appendix A of the report: 0/0 normalised diff counts for the eleven files; WebGpuBackend 18/17, all comments

findings.title: Lantern Designer items are VV-to-LD back-ports, not TV-VV; TV is already identical
findings.detail: 'Rotation path in the soup builder' and 'hidden segments through the worker pool' sit in the ledger's VV-to-TV pending table (:1226-1227). TV's SoupBuilder, WorkerPool and ClipWorker are code-identical to VV's, and the only TV change to EdgeExtractor is linework-first. The Lantern Designer folder still lacks ViewMapFromBasis and the pool's hidden segments.
findings.recommendation: Move both rows to a 'Pending Lantern Designer back-port' table and note TV parity. If they are ported to the Lantern Designer, take the post-v2.37.0 EdgeExtractor only if linework-first goes too.
findings.evidence: Ledger :39-42, :1226-1227; normalised diffs 0 lines; LD 27__System__ProjectedEdges2d search finds only ClipKernel :92,563

findings.title: TV back-port markers and header devlogs are stale or incomplete
findings.detail: The markers leave out pending Pipeline 1.5.0, Projector 1.5.0, StageSampler 1.2.0, ConfigAccess 1.2.0 and CpuBackend 1.4.0, yet still list items already ported (ConfigAccess 1.1.1, CpuBackend 1.3.1, Projector 1.4.1, ModelStage 1.2.0). Unlogged TV changes: AuthoredEdges modifier owners, GetLineworkModifiers, ClipWorker/WorkerPool owner tags, Pipeline ForgetCollections, and the Shader and Supersampler v2.103.0 fixes. LineworkModifiers has no TV devlog entry at all.
findings.recommendation: Swarm workers must take their scope from the code diff and this report's table, not from the markers. After each port, update the PORT NOTEs on both sides and log the missing entries.
findings.evidence: ref/tv_portnote_markers.txt rows for 50__System__ProjectedLinework; report Appendix B

findings.title: TV devlog v2.159.0 wrongly says ValeVision has FlushJoins 1.0.0
findings.detail: The devlog reads 'ValeVision has FlushJoins 1.0.0 with the old tolerances and the same fault waiting' (TrueVision__DEVLOG__.md:1067). VV has no FlushJoins and none of HideFlushJoins, SeamsOcclude or LineworkFirst, so it lacks the whole v2.37.0 rule set, not just the tolerance. Anyone reading the TV devlog would under-scope the port.
findings.recommendation: Correct the note in TV (WP-S02b-10) and record the real state in the VV ledger.
findings.evidence: TV devlog :1067; a search of VVM for FlushJoin|SeamsOcclude|LineworkFirst returns nothing

findings.title: TV ConfigAccess fallback build token does not match its JSON
findings.detail: The fallback buildToken is '2026-09-21-storey-swings' (:129) but the JSON's is '2026-09-23-flush-tolerance' (AppConfig:120); FlushJoins 1.1.0 bumped only the JSON. With the config unreadable, caches key under an older token than the rule that shipped, breaking the module's own rule that fallbacks mirror the JSON. A duplicated comment heading also sits at :389.
findings.recommendation: TV: set the fallback token to the JSON token and fix the heading. VV: keep the two equal after the port (WP-S02b-02 acceptance).
findings.evidence: TV 50/...ConfigAccess__.js:129, :389; TV AppConfig__.json:120

findings.title: A new BuildToken makes every VV baked linework asset stale; plan a re-bake
findings.detail: The fingerprint includes the token and the edge rules, so every R2 asset, IndexedDB copy and pipeline cache in VV will read as stale once. Localhost re-bakes on Save Floor Plans or Save Elevations, but until each live VV project is re-baked, public viewers compute linework in their own browser on first open. The asset schema stays at 2 and no worker change is needed.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a VV-specific token (for example 2026-10-xx-tv-parity) and keep the fallbacks equal to it. Then, before the next publish, run Dev > Bake All to R2 (or the saves) on an authoring machine for each live VV project.
findings.evidence: TV devlog v2.159.0 :1045-1046 (token retires baked drawings); VV Persistence header (three load gates: schema, token, fingerprint)

findings.title: Version numbers collide between apps: adopt TV numbering on whole-file ports
findings.detail: VV numbered its own ports: VV ModelStage 1.1.0 is TV 1.2.0, and VV's ClipWorker, WorkerPool and DevMenu 1.1.0 differ from TV's 1.1.0. If VV takes TV's whole files without TV's version numbers and devlogs, the collision stays and version-based parity checks (drift_all tv_ver/vv_ver) keep misleading.
findings.recommendation: When a VV file becomes TV's file, take TV's version and DEVELOPMENT LOG verbatim and add a VV PORT NOTE listing the seams. Record this convention in the ledger header.

findings.title: Supersampler premultiplied clamp (TV v2.103.0) missing in VV
findings.detail: TV's supersampler writes min(rgb, a) in its present pass (05/Na__RenderEffect__Supersampler__.js:379), and the fog shader keeps its one-step colour bump only on the supersampled path. Without the clamp, premultiplied fog layer bakes store colour above alpha (99.69% of pixels on RB05), which Chrome tolerates and other viewers may not. VV's Supersampler has no clamp.
findings.recommendation: 05 slice: add the clamp to VV's present pass before the fog sheet work. Opaque frames are unaffected.
findings.evidence: TV devlog v2.103.0 :6147-6198; TV Supersampler :373-379; no min( in VV Supersampler

findings.title: Fat-line orthographic depth bias (TV v2.38.1) missing: VV base images show lines through faces
findings.detail: VV's MultiModel applies a fixed 0.00015 log-depth bias (:683-692), which across the drawing cameras' 10 mm to 500 m range is about 75 mm. SketchUp lines therefore bleed through fascias and parapets in every VV plan and elevation base image, sheet underlay and export. TV v2.38.1 gives orthographic cameras RenderConfig__Linework__OrthoDepthBiasMm (2 mm) and leaves perspective unchanged. TV row X was pending 'if ValeVision's loader carries the same fixed depth bias' - it does.
findings.recommendation: 15 ModelLoader slice: port the MultiModel 1.3.0 hunk and add the Main-config key (2). Verify with a pixel diff on a VV elevation: the setback lines go and perspective renders are unchanged.
findings.evidence: VV 15/Na__ModelLoader__MultiModel.js:683-692; TV Main config :90 OrthoDepthBiasMm 2; realign plan row X :871-874
